dev.envMissing: Supabase keys are missing. Copy .env.example to .env and fill it in. Backend calls are disabled.

screens.comingSoonBody: This screen is not built yet. It arrives in phase {{phase}} of the build plan.

pwa.installBody: Add it to your home screen for a full-screen app and faster access.
pwa.installIosBody: Tap the Share button, then “Add to Home Screen”.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Start your 14-day free trial. No card needed.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: We'll email you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Pick something you haven't used before.
reset.doneBody: You can now sign in with your new password.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.subtitle: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to finish setting up your account.
verify.wrongEmail: Wrong email? Sign out and start again.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

onboarding.title: Set up your business
onboarding.subtitle: This takes a minute. You can change everything later.

hints.branchName: Leave blank to use your business name.
hints.currency: Used on this location's invoices. It cannot change once invoices exist.
hints.timezone: Appointment times at this location use this.
hints.country: Sets tax rules and SMS rates for this location.

errors.slugFormat: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only
errors.slugReserved: That address is reserved. Please pick another.

onboarding.locationIntro: These settings belong to this location. If you add more locations later, each one can have its own country, currency and timezone.

noAccess.title: You do not have access to this page
noAccess.description: Your role does not include this area. Ask an owner or manager if you need it.

empty.title: No team members yet
empty.description: Invite the people who work with you so they can take bookings.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.subtitle: They get a link that works for 7 days.
invite.roleHint: You can only grant permissions you have yourself.
invite.linkOnce: Copy it now and send it to them. It is shown only once and works for 7 days.

accept.title: Join the team
accept.invalid: That invite link is not valid. It may have expired or already been used. Ask for a new one.
accept.joinAs: You have been invited to join {{business}} as {{email}}.
accept.createFor: You have been invited to join {{business}}. Create your account for {{email}} to continue.
accept.confirmEmail: Check your email to confirm your address, then open the invite link again.
accept.wrongAccount: This invite is for {{invited}}. Sign out and sign in with that address to accept it.

locked.title: Your trial has ended
locked.trialEnded: Your 14-day trial is over, so this business is paused. Get in touch and we will set up a plan for you.
locked.suspended: This business has been paused. Get in touch and we will help you sort it out.
locked.dataSafe: Nothing has been deleted. Your bookings, clients and invoices are all still here.

schedule.dateFormatHint: Use the format YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-12-25.

empty.title: No services yet
empty.description: Add what you sell so customers can book it.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this service?
deleteConfirm.message: It will be hidden from new bookings. Past appointments and invoices keep it.

fields.name: Name
fields.categoryHint: Optional. Groups services on the booking page.
fields.bufferHint: Clean-up time before the next booking.

errors.durationTooShort: A service must be at least 5 minutes
errors.durationTooLong: A service cannot be longer than a day

deleteConfirm.title: Remove this staff member?
deleteConfirm.message: They will be hidden from new bookings. Their past appointments stay.
